strings.zh: 「{VAR:0300:0}」{SCROLL}瞄准旋转的吞食兽的嘴巴{NEWLINE}把树果放进去吧！{SCROLL}只有连续放入{NEWLINE}得分才会增加！{SCROLL}进入狂热时间后{NEWLINE}能得到额外的分数！{SCROLL}瞄准了再放,{NEWLINE}还是不断地扔进去,{CLEAR}就看你自己了！{SCROLL}
strings.en: {VAR:0300:0}{SCROLL}Flick Berries into the mouth of a{NEWLINE}rotating Swalot.{SCROLL}Score bonus points for getting Berries{NEWLINE}in consecutively.{SCROLL}Score even more during Fever Time.{SCROLL}Take deliberate aim or fire randomly--{NEWLINE}the choice is yours!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 「{VAR:0300:0}」{SCROLL}为了不让魔尼尼摔倒,{NEWLINE}好好地滚动球吧！{SCROLL}如果能一直站在球上{NEWLINE}灯光就会闪烁,{CLEAR}大家就会热烈鼓掌！{SCROLL}如果全员都能站在球上,{NEWLINE}能一直站住,{CLEAR}幕布也会渐渐上升！{SCROLL}不要掉下来{NEWLINE}大家好好地站在球上吧！{SCROLL}
strings.en: {VAR:0300:0}{SCROLL}Roll a ball while keeping a Mime Jr.{NEWLINE}balanced on top.{SCROLL}If the Mime Jr. manages to stay on,{NEWLINE}lights flash and the applause begins.{SCROLL}If everyone manages to keep going,{NEWLINE}the curtains will rise.{SCROLL}Try to keep your Mime Jr. balanced{NEWLINE}and on the ball!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 「{VAR:0300:0}」{SCROLL}把泵从上面直直压下,{NEWLINE}充入大量的空气,{CLEAR}一个一个地打破气球！{SCROLL}一下一下压下到泵变红的话{NEWLINE}充入的空气就会增加！{SCROLL}然后如果好好配合{NEWLINE}周围的小果然的话,{CLEAR}就能充入更多的空气！{SCROLL}不过就算是相同的小果然,{NEWLINE}碰到细的小果然的话,{CLEAR}空气也会减少,要小心！{SCROLL}
strings.en: {VAR:0300:0}{SCROLL}Press down on the pump from{NEWLINE}directly above to pump maximum{CLEAR}air into a balloon until it pops.{SCROLL}Pop balloons until time runs out.{SCROLL}Pressing the pump hard will make it{NEWLINE}turn red, increasing its capacity.{SCROLL}The circling Wynaut can also help.{SCROLL}Line a Wynaut up with the pump to{NEWLINE}boost the air volume, but beware:{SCROLL}lining up the pump with a skinny{NEWLINE}Wynaut reduces the air volume.{SCROLL}
